title: Fake Merc Character Study (part. 8): Muddle Class income
summary: Episode 8 of his long mockery series on the YouTuber he calls Bloho/Fake Merc, covering the years-long troll campaign against him, the dislike-bot claims, his Dunning-Kruger know-it-all persona, a failed Will Tennyson shoutout, and his fabricated middle-class lifestyle (vacations, 4am wake-ups, the overflow fridge). Mostly personal ridicule with a few side remarks on lifting and lying.
claims: Hate campaigns against YouTubers usually burn out within months to a year; one lasting six or seven years means the target never changed his ways
On YouTube fitness, people watch out of hate more than love; hate is a more consuming energy
Modern YouTube fitness is dominated by good-looking guys on TRT with good camera gear; a fallen creator cannot come back
YouTube detects fraudulent dislikes and removes them; mass dislikes usually come from people using sock accounts, not bots
Someone who instantly claims to already know every topic is usually full of it
Scheduling deloads matters; deloading whenever you feel like it is not programming
Effective lies are short and tied to reality; liars pile on details that eventually unravel the whole story
Waking up early does not make you productive; what counts is how much you slept and how much you work
He records his videos about a week in advance
A channel of thousands of videos with no playlists is bad business; YouTube does not surface old videos without organization
